title: Trump Says He Canceled Strikes on Iran, Claiming Progress on Outlines of a Deal
summary_full: President Trump said he agreed to requests from Iran and other Middle Eastern countries to cancel planned attacks, citing what he said was progress in reaching the “perimeters of a deal” with Tehran.
